trouble.definitionKo: 다른 사람에게 피해를 주거나 문제를 일으키는 나쁜 일.
trouble.englishDescription: A bad thing that does harm to others or causes a problem

trouble.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하는 데 장애가 되는 것.
trouble.englishDescription: A thing that acts as a barrier to doing something.

trouble.definitionKo: 걱정이나 근심 등으로 마음을 몹시 괴롭게 하다.
trouble.englishDescription: To torment one's mind with a worry, concern, etc.
Worries or troubles occurring in a family.

trouble.definitionKo: 어수선하게 계속되는 여러 가지 변화나 어려움.
trouble.englishDescription: Various, continued changes or difficulties that trouble someone.

trouble.definitionKo: 남에게 손해를 끼치거나 남을 귀찮게 하는 일.
trouble.englishDescription: An act of causing damage to someone or bothering someone.
A thing that is difficult and painful to do.
(figurative) Troubles and chaos.
A difficulty or pain faced while living one's life.

trudgingly.englishDescription: A word describing one's walking in weak, slow steps.

trudgingly.definitionKo: 지치거나 기운이 없어서 무거운 발걸음으로 계속 힘없이 걷는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
trudgingly.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when one walks weakly with heavy steps due to exhaustion or lack of energy, or such a scene.

trudgingly.definitionKo: 매우 느리게 힘없는 걸음으로 걸어가는 모양.
trudgingly.englishDescription: A word describing one's walking in very weak, slow steps.

uncouth.definitionKo: 말이 매우 무식하고 천하거나 하는 행동이 사납고 못되다.
uncouth.englishDescription: A person's manner of speaking being uneducated and uncivilized, or a person's behavior being fierce and wicked.

uprising.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 어떤 목적을 위해 함께 일어나 행동함.
uprising.englishDescription: Several people rise up and act together for a certain purpose.

uprising.definitionKo: (옛날에) 부패한 정치에 반대하여 백성들이 일으키는 폭동.
uprising.englishDescription: (archaic) A rebellion by the people in opposition to corrupt politics.

uprising.definitionKo: 정부나 지도자 등에 반대하여 공격하거나 싸움을 일으킴.
uprising.englishDescription: The act of starting a fight against or attacking a government or its leaders as a way of opposing them.

uprising.definitionKo: 아주 많은 사람들이 정권에 반대하거나 항의하여 나섬.
uprising.englishDescription: A revolt caused by a large group of people in opposition to or protest against the government.

uprising.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 집단으로 폭력 행위를 일으켜 사회를 어지럽게 하는 일.
uprising.englishDescription: An act of many people, as a group, starting violence and causing confusion in society.

ventilator.definitionKo: 방 안의 더럽고 탁한 공기를 내보내고 바깥의 맑은 공기를 들어오게 하는 기구.
ventilator.englishDescription: An implement that sends out dirty and murky indoor air and lets fresh outdoor air in.

ventilator.definitionKo: 더럽고 탁한 공기를 맑은 공기로 바꾸기 위해 실내와 바깥이 통하게 뚫은 구멍.
ventilator.englishDescription: A hole made to connect the inside to the outside of a building to replace dirty, stuffy air with fresh air.

venus.definitionKo: 태양에서 둘째로 가까운, 수성과 지구 사이에 있는 행성.
venus.englishDescription: The second planet from the sun that is located between Mercury and Earth.

venus.definitionKo: 새벽에 동쪽 하늘에서 보이는 별인 금성.
venus.englishDescription: Venus, a star seen in the eastern sky at dawn.

vigor.englishDescription: A very strong and vigorous spirit.
The vigor or vitality which extends strongly.

vigor.definitionKo: 어떤 힘겨운 일이라도 해내려는 굳센 정신.
vigor.englishDescription: A strong spirit in which one would try to seek a goal, despite any difficulties.
Vigor or vitality that extends strongly.
The energy or power to do something.

vigor.definitionKo: 세상의 모든 것이 살아 움직이는 활발한 기운.
vigor.englishDescription: The vigorous energy coming from all living things in the world.

vociferously.definitionKo: 무슨 일에 괜히 참견하여 시끄럽게 떠들며 무뚝뚝한 말씨로 따지는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
vociferously.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the act of someone criticizing bluntly and noisily while meddling in another's affair.

whaling.englishDescription: The act of catching a whale.

whip.definitionKo: 사람이나 짐승을 때리는 막대기. 또는 그것으로 때리는 일.
whip.englishDescription: A stick with which to beat a person or animal, or the act of beating with such a stick.
To beat someone with a whip, a rod etc.

whip.definitionKo: 가느다란 막대기의 끝에 노끈이나 가죽끈을 달아 말이나 소를 때려 모는 데 쓰는 물건.
whip.englishDescription: A tool made by attaching strings or leather strips to the tip of a stick that is used for whipping and driving horses or cattle.
To beat a person or animal with a whip.

whip.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 몹시 재촉하여 다그치거나 힘이 나도록 북돋아 주다.
whip.englishDescription: (figurative) To rush or encourage to raise one's spirits by pressing.

whip.definitionKo: 가느다란 막대기의 끝에 노끈이나 가죽끈을 달아 말이나 소를 때려 모는 데 쓰는 물건.
whip.englishDescription: A tool made by attaching strings or leather strips to the tip of a stick that is used for whipping and driving horses or cattle.

whip.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물의 몸 등을 주먹이나 채찍 등으로 매우 힘껏 때리거나 치다.
whip.englishDescription: To strongly hit or strike a person or an animal body with a fist or whip.

whip.definitionKo: 주먹이나 채찍 등을 휘둘러 힘껏 때리거나 치다.
whip.englishDescription: To slap or hit another person hard, wielding a whip or throwing a punch.
To stir something from side to side wildly to mix it throughly.

whopping.definitionKo: 생각한 것보다 그 수나 양이 많게.
whopping.englishDescription: In a state in which the number or amount is larger than one thought.

wile.definitionKo: 자기의 이익을 위해 부리는 나쁜 꾀.
wile.englishDescription: A wicked scheme or plot designed to advance one's interests.

wile.definitionKo: 자기의 이익을 위해 남을 속이고 해치려는 나쁜 꾀. 또는 그러한 꾀를 부리는 것.
wile.englishDescription: A trick to deceive or harm others to pursue one's own profit; or an act of devising such a trick.

winner.englishDescription: A person chosen in a screening or selection.

winner.definitionKo: 관심을 받고 있는 것의 중심이 되는 사람.
winner.englishDescription: A person who is at the center of something that receives attention.

winner.definitionKo: 싸움이나 경기 등에서 이긴 사람. 또는 그런 단체.
winner.englishDescription: The person who wins a fight, game, etc., or such a group.

winner.definitionKo: 경기나 시합에서 상대를 모두 이겨 일 위를 차지한 사람.
winner.englishDescription: A person who defeats all opponents and takes the first place in a contest or competition.

winner.definitionKo: 어려움을 이겨 내고 자기 뜻을 이룬 사람.
winner.englishDescription: A person who overcomes difficulties and achieves what he/she dreams of.

winner.definitionKo: 옛날에 과거 시험에서 첫째 등급에서 첫째로 뽑힘, 또는 그 사람.
winner.englishDescription: The act of being selected as the winner of the first-tier contest in the ancient civil service exam system, or such a winner.

winner.definitionKo: 백일장 등에서 가장 우수한 성적으로 뽑힘, 또는 그런 사람.
winner.englishDescription: The act of being selected as the winner in an essay contest, etc.

winner.definitionKo: 시험, 검사, 심사 등을 통과하여 어떤 자격이나 지위를 얻은 사람.
winner.englishDescription: A person who attains a certain qualification or status by passing a test, inspection, screening, etc.

wisteria.definitionKo: 봄에 향기로운 연한 보랏빛 꽃이 송이를 이루어 피고 여름에 그늘이 짙은, 뜰에 심는 큰 덩굴나무.
wisteria.englishDescription: A big climber planted in the yard, of which the fragrant light purple flower clusters bloom in the spring and which provides dense shade in the summer.

workplace.englishDescription: A place where someone works for money.

workplace.definitionKo: 직장에서 주로 서류 등을 처리하며 자신이 맡은 일을 하는 방.
workplace.englishDescription: A room at work for working on a given task, usually doing paperwork, etc.
A certain place where business activities take place.
A place where one does work.
A place where one does work as one's job.
A place where one does work.

wrench.definitionKo: 몸의 한 부분이 충격을 받아 접히거나 비틀려서 뼈마디가 어긋나다.
wrench.englishExpression: have a wrick in; sprain; wrench
wrench.englishDescription: For a joint of a part of one's body to be twisted or bent strongly and dislocated.

wrench.definitionKo: 몸이나 팔다리를 이리저리 돌려 비틀어 꼬다.
wrench.englishDescription: To contort and twist one's body or arms and legs.

wring.englishDescription: To wind something by twisting it tightly.

wring.definitionKo: 남을 속이거나 위협하여 돈이나 물건을 얻어 내다.
wring.englishDescription: To take money, objects, etc., from another person by deceiving or intimidating him/her.

wring.definitionKo: 남을 속이거나 위협하여 돈이나 물품 등을 빼앗다.
wring.englishDescription: To take money, objects, etc., from another person by deceiving or intimidating him/her.

wring.definitionKo: 자원이나 재산, 노동력 등을 정당한 대가를 주지 않고 빼앗아 이용하다.
wring.englishDescription: To take resources, property, labor, etc., forcefully and utilize them unjustly.

yearbook.definitionKo: 어떤 분야에서 일 년 동안 일어난 사건과 통계, 과정 등을 수록하여 일 년에 한 번씩 발행하는 정기 간행물.
yearbook.englishDescription: A periodical published once a year, which includes information on yearly incidents, statistics, processes, etc., in an area.

yet.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 상태 또는 어떻게 되기까지 시간이 더 지나야 함을 나타내거나, 어떤 일이나 상태가 끝나지 않고 계속 이어지고 있음을 나타내는 말.
yet.englishDescription: An adverb used to indicate that more time is needed to reach a certain state, or that something or a certain state has not ended, but is going on.
